THE CHALLENGE

Why this is hard today.

Three clouds, three consoles

Each provider reports posture in its own shape, which makes comparison slow.

Findings without scope

A configuration issue is hard to judge without knowing which assets and accounts it touches.

Cloud roles drift

Permissions granted for one workload often outlive the reason they were given.

HOW SAFORA HELPS

Three steps, one workspace.

  1. 01

    Choose a cloud view

    Open Azure Security, AWS Security or Microsoft 365 Security in the same workspace layout.

  2. 02

    Review findings in scope

    See priority findings with their affected assets and the assessment pass rate.

  3. 03

    Investigate with the owner

    Use the evidence and guidance on a finding to plan a change with the resource owner.
